imageRegistry.description: Registry that replaces every image's `registry` (for mirrors / air-gapped clusters). Empty keeps each image's own registry.

imagePullSecrets.description: Pull secrets (names of existing `kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson` Secrets) added to every pod.

storageClass.description: Default StorageClass for every PVC. Empty uses the cluster default; `-` sets `storageClassName: ""`.

runtimeClassName.description: Default RuntimeClass for every pod (for example `gvisor`). A component's own `runtimeClassName` wins.

nodeSelector.description: Default nodeSelector for every pod. A component's own `nodeSelector` replaces it when non-empty.

tolerations.description: Default tolerations for every pod. A component's own `tolerations` replace them when non-empty.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext applied to every container (merged under each component's `securityContext`). Meets Pod Security Standard "restricted".

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name part of resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full release name prefix used by every resource (max 40 characters recommended).

enabled.description: Create a NetworkPolicy that only admits ingress from pods of this release (same namespace) plus `extraIngressFrom`. HMS, Trino and Ollama have no authentication in this setup (see the chart README), so keep this on in shared clusters.

extraIngressFrom.description: Extra NetworkPolicyPeer entries allowed to reach every component (for example the consumer's namespace).

endpoint.description: External S3 endpoint URL. Leave empty to use the bundled SeaweedFS (requires `seaweedfs.enabled`).

bucket.description: Bucket holding the warehouse. The bundled SeaweedFS creates it; an external bucket must already exist.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the S3 access key pair. Empty: the chart generates `<fullname>-s3`.

accessKeyKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the access key ID.

secretKeyKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the secret access key.

enabled.description: Deploy SeaweedFS (single-node master + volume + filer + S3 gateway).

volumeMax.description: Maximum number of volumes. Must stay explicit: auto-sizing from free disk can leave no writable volume (S3 PUT 500).

volumeSizeLimitMB.description: Size limit of one volume, in MB.

enabled.description: Use a PVC for `/data`. `false` uses an emptyDir (data is lost with the pod).

storageClass.description: StorageClass for this PVC. Empty falls back to `global.storageClass`; `-` sets `storageClassName: ""`.

enabled.description: Deploy the Hive Metastore (Thrift on 9083, built-in Iceberg REST catalog on 9084) and its Postgres.

repository.description: Image repository (built from `hive-metastore/Dockerfile`, published by the release workflow).

extraProperties.description: Extra `<property>` entries appended to metastore-site.xml (name -> value).

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the database password. Empty: the chart generates `<fullname>-hms-db`.

passwordKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the password.

enabled.description: Use a PVC for the database. `false` uses an emptyDir.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for this PVC. Empty falls back to `global.storageClass`; `-` sets `storageClassName: ""`.

enabled.description: Deploy a Spark Connect server (gRPC 15002). Requires `hms.enabled`.

repository.description: Image repository (built from `spark/Dockerfile`; also used for executors and `helm test`).

tag.description: Image tag (lab release; Spark 4.1.3 + Iceberg 1.12.0 inside).

master.description: Where executors run: `kubernetes` (executor pods in the release namespace, namespaced RBAC) or `local` (threads inside the server pod, no RBAC).

enabled.description: Require a bearer token from Spark Connect clients (`sc://host:15002/;token=...`).

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the token. Empty: the chart generates `<fullname>-spark-connect`.

tokenKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the token.

instances.description: Number of executor pods (`master: kubernetes`) or threads (`master: local`).

memory.description: Executor JVM memory (`spark.executor.memory`). Pod memory adds `spark.executor.memoryOverhead` (default 384m).

limitCores.description: CPU limit per executor pod. Empty sets none.

icebergCatalogName.description: Name of the Iceberg catalog registered in Spark (points at the HMS Iceberg REST catalog).

extraConf.description: Extra Spark properties written to spark-defaults.conf.

create.description: Create a ServiceAccount for the Connect server (it creates executor pods when `master: kubernetes`).
Create a namespaced Role/RoleBinding letting the Connect server manage executor pods, ConfigMaps and PVCs.

runtimeClassName.description: RuntimeClass for the server and executor pods.

nodeSelector.description: nodeSelector for the server and executor pods.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for the server and executor pods.

affinity.description: Affinity for the Connect server pod.

podLabels.description: Extra labels for the server and executor pods.

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations for the server and executor pods.

enabled.description: Deploy the Spark History Server (UI + REST on 18080). Turns on Spark event logging to `eventLogDir`. Requires `spark.enabled`. Uses `spark.image`. A running Spark Connect server appears here only after it stops or rolls a log file (S3 shows a file only once it is closed); use the live Spark UI (port 4040) for the running server.

eventLogDir.description: Event log location written by Spark and read by the History Server. Empty: `s3a://<s3.bucket>/spark-events`.

rollingMaxFileSize.description: Roll the Spark Connect server's event log at this size so a long-running server shows up in history (Spark minimum: 10m).

cleanerMaxAge.description: Delete event logs older than this.

heapSize.description: JVM heap of the History Server (`SPARK_DAEMON_MEMORY`).

enabled.description: Deploy the Kubeflow Spark History Server MCP server (streamable HTTP on 18888, path `/mcp`). No caller authentication: reachable only through the NetworkPolicy. Requires `sparkHistory.enabled`. Queries the History Server (`history`, default) and, when Spark is enabled, the live Spark Connect UI (`live`).

liveServer.description: Also query the live Spark UI of the running Spark Connect server (MCP server name `live`); `history` is always the default.

timeout.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for calls to the History Server / Spark UI.

includePlanDescription.description: Include SQL plan descriptions in SQL tool results (larger responses, more detail for query tuning).

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the MCP container (list of EnvVar).

enabled.description: Deploy the Astronomer Airflow MCP server (streamable HTTP on 8000, path `/mcp`). Logs in to Airflow as its own least-privilege user (`username`). No caller authentication: reachable only through the NetworkPolicy. Requires `airflow.enabled`.

repository.description: Image repository (built from `airflow-mcp/Dockerfile`: astro-airflow-mcp 0.9.1, published by the release workflow).

readOnly.description: Read-only mode. `true`: the MCP's Airflow user gets the `viewer` role and the MCP blocks write tools, so Airflow itself rejects writes too. `false`: the user gets the `op` role (trigger, pause, clear; no admin settings).

username.description: Dedicated Airflow user the MCP logs in as (added to Airflow's SimpleAuthManager users).

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the MCP user's Airflow password. Empty: the chart generates `<fullname>-airflow-mcp`.

passwordKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the password.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the MCP container (list of EnvVar).

enabled.description: Deploy a single-node Trino (coordinator also schedules work). Requires `hms.enabled`.

heapSize.description: JVM max heap (`-Xmx`). Keep it about 75% of the memory limit.

additionalCatalogs.description: Extra catalogs: catalog name -> properties file content. `hive`, `iceberg` and `lakehouse` are always created.

enabled.description: Deploy Airflow 3 (LocalExecutor) in one pod: api-server, scheduler, dag-processor (+ optional triggerer), with its own Postgres.

username.description: Admin username for the API / UI (SimpleAuthManager).

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the admin password. Empty: the chart generates `<fullname>-airflow`.

passwordKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the admin password.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding `fernet-key`, `jwt-secret` and `api-secret-key`. Empty: the chart generates them in `<fullname>-airflow`.

enabled.description: Run the triggerer (needed for deferrable operators).

source.description: Where DAG files come from: `pvc`, `gitSync` or `none` (empty dir).

subPath.description: Path inside the DAG source that holds the DAG files (git-sync: inside the repo).

existingClaim.description: Existing PVC with the DAGs (an external agent writes to it). Empty: the chart creates `<fullname>-airflow-dags`.

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the chart-created PVC. Empty falls back to `global.storageClass`; `-` sets `storageClassName: ""`.

accessModes.description: Access modes of the chart-created PVC. Use `ReadWriteMany` if another pod writes DAGs while Airflow runs.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit to sync.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret with git credentials: keys `username`/`password` (HTTPS) or `ssh-privatekey` (+ optional `known_hosts`).

enabled.description: Keep task logs on a PVC so they stay viewable in the UI after pod restarts (LocalExecutor: tasks and api-server share this volume). `false` uses an emptyDir: logs survive task completion but not a pod restart.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for this PVC. Empty falls back to `global.storageClass`; `-` sets `storageClassName: ""`.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for every Airflow container (list of EnvVar).

resources.description: Resources of each Airflow container (api-server, scheduler, dag-processor, triggerer).

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the database password (must be URL-safe). Empty: the chart generates `<fullname>-airflow-db`.

passwordKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the password.

enabled.description: Use a PVC for the database. `false` uses an emptyDir.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for this PVC. Empty falls back to `global.storageClass`; `-` sets `storageClassName: ""`.

enabled.description: Deploy JupyterLab (connects to Spark Connect, Trino and the GenAI services that are enabled).

repository.description: Image repository (built from `jupyter/Dockerfile`, published by the release workflow).

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the Jupyter token. Empty: the chart generates `<fullname>-jupyter`.

tokenKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the token.

enabled.description: Use a PVC for `/home/jovyan/work`. `false` uses an emptyDir.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for this PVC. Empty falls back to `global.storageClass`; `-` sets `storageClassName: ""`.

existingClaim.description: Use this existing PVC for `/home/jovyan/work` instead of creating one (e.g. the workstation's host-folder PV).

enabled.description: Deploy Ollama (local LLM server, no authentication). Needs a GPU to be useful; CPU works but is slow.

models.description: Models pulled at startup (for example `llama3.2:3b`). Pod readiness waits for the pulls.

enabled.description: Request GPUs.

resourceName.description: Extended resource name of the GPU.

enabled.description: Use a PVC for models. `false` uses an emptyDir.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for this PVC. Empty falls back to `global.storageClass`; `-` sets `storageClassName: ""`.

enabled.description: Deploy Qdrant (vector database, API-key protected).

tag.description: Image tag (the `-unprivileged` variant runs as uid 1000).

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the API key. Empty: the chart generates `<fullname>-qdrant`.

apiKeyKey.description: Key in the Secret holding the API key.

enabled.description: Use a PVC for `/qdrant/storage`. `false` uses an emptyDir.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for this PVC. Empty falls back to `global.storageClass`; `-` sets `storageClassName: ""`.

enabled.description: Deploy Arize Phoenix (LLM tracing; OTLP gRPC 4317, UI + OTLP HTTP 6006). SQLite storage.
Enable Phoenix authentication (admin user + API keys).

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding `secret` (token signing, >= 32 chars) and `admin-password`. Empty: the chart generates `<fullname>-phoenix`.

enabled.description: Use a PVC for the SQLite working dir. `false` uses an emptyDir.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for this PVC. Empty falls back to `global.storageClass`; `-` sets `storageClassName: ""`.

enabled.description: Render the `helm test` pod (Spark writes an Iceberg table through Spark Connect, Trino reads it, then it is dropped). Needs `spark` and `trino`.
